source.title: Why Your Big Toe Unlocks Glute Activation

segments.transcript: Your big toe's ability to properly connect with the ground is probably the most single underrated element of glued activation that most people aren't aware of here's why there's two main things we need to understand for this the first is that the glute max muscle primarily creates hip extension or it's straightens out our hips the second is that hip extension is cute when we're moving through the world in the gate cycle when our big toe makes contact with the ground and we're going to pull our body weight over that leg

payload.title: Why Your Big Toe Unlocks Glute Activation

segments.transcript: Your big toe's ability to properly connect with the ground is probably the most single underrated element of glued activation that most people aren't aware of here's why there's two main things we need to understand for this the first is that the glute max muscle primarily creates hip extension or it's straightens out our hips the second is that hip extension is cute when we're moving through the world in the gate cycle when our big toe makes contact with the ground and we're going to pull our body weight over that leg So what we're trying to say here is that there's an inherent important connection between this part of your toe connecting with the ground and you being able to properly use your glutes and produce force You oftentimes see what people that have low back pain or knee pain during exercises they're just throughout the day they have a hard time getting this big toe down and connected with the floor, especially when you see them do exercises like squats or split squats
